executiveSummary.text: Ribbit Rampage is an arcade action driving survival game designed for PC, focusing on delivering a chaotic and intense gameplay experience. The project aims to create a vertical slice that showcases the core gameplay mechanics, enemy interactions, and visual style. This phase will serve as a foundation for future expansions and adaptations. The project will be executed in a phased delivery approach, ensuring cost efficiency and timely delivery.

executiveSummary.text: Rabbit Rampage is an arcade action driving survival game targeting the PC platform. The game features a fast-paced, chaotic environment where players must navigate through a jungle terrain while avoiding attacks from various frog enemies. The project aims to deliver a vertical slice that demonstrates core gameplay mechanics, enemy interactions, and visual style. The focus is on creating a polished, playable experience that can be used for pitching and further development.

proposals.title: Plaza Event Booking
proposals.description: Plaza Event Booking is a comprehensive digital platform for GrandHall, a luxury hotel, to streamline the process of discovering, personalizing, and booking event halls. It aims to provide a seamless experience for use…

conceptData.overview: Plaza Event Booking is a comprehensive digital platform for GrandHall, a luxury hotel, to streamline the process of discovering, personalizing, and booking event halls. It aims to provide a seamless experience for users booking various events, including weddings, corporate functions, and kids' parties, with a focus on eliminating user frustration and ensuring clarity in every interaction.
conceptData.problemStatement: The platform addresses the challenge of efficiently booking event spaces by providing a user-friendly interface that reduces confusion and ensures transparency in pricing, availability, and options, catering to both individual and organizational needs.

targetPlatforms.rationale: Essential for broad accessibility and detailed browsing of event halls with rich media content.
Provides on-the-go access for users to book and manage events, ensuring a seamless experience across devices.
Handles business logic, user authentication, and data management, ensuring secure and efficient operations.
Allows hotel staff to manage bookings, update availability, and communicate with clients effectively.

userTypes.description: Individuals or organizations looking to book event spaces for various occasions.
Hotel staff responsible for managing event bookings and customer interactions.

architectureOverview.description: The architecture consists of a web and mobile frontend, a robust backend API, and an admin portal for hotel staff. These components interact to provide a seamless booking experience.

components.name: Web Application
components.purpose: User interface for browsing and booking event halls

components.name: Mobile Application
components.purpose: Mobile access for users to book and manage events

components.name: Backend API
components.purpose: Handles business logic and data management

components.name: Database
components.purpose: Stores user data, bookings, and event details

architectureOverview.dataFlow: Data flows from the frontend applications to the backend API, which processes requests and interacts with the database to retrieve or store information. The admin portal interfaces with the backend to manage data and operations.

techStack.rationale: Allows for cross-platform development, reducing time and cost while maintaining a native-like experience.
Provides a robust framework for building dynamic and responsive user interfaces.
Offers a scalable solution with a large ecosystem, ideal for handling asynchronous operations and real-time data.
A powerful, open-source relational database system known for reliability and performance.
Facilitates containerization, ensuring consistent environments across development and production.

keyFeatures.description: Secure user registration and login options including social sign-ins.

keyFeatures.description: Search and filter event halls based on capacity, date, and amenities.

keyFeatures.description: Step-by-step booking process from date selection to payment.

keyFeatures.description: Child-safety features and add-ons for kids' events.

keyFeatures.description: Interface for hotel staff to manage bookings and communicate with clients.

keyFeatures.name: Post-Booking Management
keyFeatures.description: Dashboard for users to manage and modify their bookings.

keyFeatures.name: Payment Integration
keyFeatures.description: Secure payment processing with multiple options.

keyFeatures.name: Event Package Customization
keyFeatures.description: Select and customize event packages and add-ons.

keyFeatures.name: Notifications & Reminders
keyFeatures.description: Automated notifications for key booking milestones.

keyFeatures.name: Review & Feedback System
keyFeatures.description: Allow users to leave reviews and feedback post-event.
